decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range is a close extension of the firm's existing safety-footwear knowledge, so management is likely to keep it and refine it rather than exit quickly despite limited public evidence after launch.

An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe builds on related technical, certification and production capabilities already present in a German safety-shoe maker, which supports continued learning and commercial improvement.
A safety shoe series sits most directly in the firm's core competence, so under an absorptive-capacity logic it is the kind of product the firm is best able to interpret, improve and retain.
